'''Mos Taike''' was a settlement<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> built on the western edge of the [[Northern Dune Sea]] on the north side of the [[Mospic High Range]] in the small habitable region in the northern hemisphere of the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. It stood eight [[kilometer]]s (five miles) southeast of the settlement of [[Mos Entha]], with the settlement of [[Mos Espa]] standing 20 kilometers (12.5 miles) away from Mos Taike in the same direction.<ref name="CL" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the [[Secret mission to Tatooine]], as depicted in [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], to [[1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jawa]] [[sandcrawler]]<ref name="CL" /> commanded by [[Chief]] [[Nebit]]<ref name="Nebit">{{ForceCollection|Nebit|star=1}}</ref> planned to pass through Mos Taike as part of a circuit it traveled; however, the vehicle never reached the settlement as the [[Nebit's tribe|Jawas]] on board were [[Death|killed]] by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s part way through their route.<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Mos Taike was first mentioned in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']].<ref name="CL" /> The [[Mos Taike/Legends|settlement]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]] with illustrations by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="ItWoSW: EpI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> It then appeared for the first time in Legends in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=location|[[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]]|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>
